response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong general software engineering practices, communication skills, and experience with high-performance systems, they fall significantly short of the mandatory technical requirements. C++ experience is limited to 6 months at National Instruments (2014-2015) with an 11-year gap—well below the required 5–10 years. Critically, there is zero demonstrated experience in capital markets, fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking domains. Recent career focus on TypeScript/Node.js web development and AI tooling does not align with this role's requirements for hands-on C++ and financial systems expertise.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship practices including TDD, CI/CD, and testing-focused development
Proven ability to work on low-latency, high-performance distributed systems at Dunnhumby
Excellent verbal and written communication demonstrated through workshops, talks, and mentoring initiatives
concerns: Only 6 months of professional C++ experience with an 11-year gap; career has shifted to web/cloud technologies
Zero capital markets, fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking domain experience—a mandatory requirement
Recent work on direct mail automation, web platforms, and AI agent infrastructure with no evidence of Windows platform expertise or financial systems development

key_factors.factor: No capital markets or financial domain experience
Strong general software engineering and communication fundamentals
